datasets.name: ds_wh
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT qh.compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, qh.execution_status,
    qh.total_duration_ms,
    COALESCE(qh.waiting_for_compute_duration_ms,0) AS wait_cold_ms,
    COALESCE(qh.waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms,0) AS wait_cap_ms,
    COALESCE(qh.spilled_local_bytes,0) AS spilled_local_bytes
  FROM system.query.history qh
  WHERE qh.start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 7)
    AND qh.compute.type='WAREHOUSE' AND qh.compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
),
wh AS (
  SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, UPPER(warehouse_size) AS warehouse_size,
    min_clusters, max_clusters, auto_stop_minutes,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) rn
  FROM system.compute.warehouses WHERE delete_time IS NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, base.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_name,
  w.warehouse_type, w.warehouse_size, w.min_clusters, w.max_clusters, w.auto_stop_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS queries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN base.execution_status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_queries,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN base.execution_status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/COUNT(*),4) AS failure_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(base.spilled_local_bytes)/POWER(1024.0,3),2) AS spill_gib,
  ROUND(SUM(base.wait_cap_ms)/60000.0,2) AS capacity_queue_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(base.wait_cold_ms)/60000.0,2) AS coldstart_minutes,
  ROUND((SUM(base.wait_cap_ms)+SUM(base.wait_cold_ms))/60000.0,2) AS queue_minutes,
  ROUND(AVG(base.total_duration_ms)/1000.0,2) AS avg_runtime_sec
FROM base LEFT JOIN wh w ON w.warehouse_id=base.warehouse_id AND w.rn=1
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
ORDER BY queue_minutes DESC

datasets.name: ds_trend
queryLines:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', qh.start_time) AS day,
  COUNT(*) AS queries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qh.execution_status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_queries,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(qh.spilled_local_bytes,0))/POWER(1024.0,3),2) AS spill_gib,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(qh.waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms,0)+COALESCE(qh.waiting_for_compute_duration_ms,0))/60000.0,2) AS queue_minutes
FROM system.query.history qh
WHERE qh.start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 14)
  AND qh.compute.type='WAREHOUSE' AND qh.compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_reco
queryLines:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT 1.0 AS spill_gib_threshold, 10.0 AS capacity_queue_min_threshold, 5.0 AS coldstart_min_threshold,
         0.1 AS low_spill_gib_threshold, 1.0 AS low_capacity_queue_min_threshold, 1.0 AS low_total_queue_min_threshold
),
base_wh AS (
  SELECT qh.statement_id, qh.workspace_id, qh.compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, qh.start_time, qh.execution_status,
    qh.total_duration_ms,
    COALESCE(qh.waiting_for_compute_duration_ms,0) AS wait_cold_ms,
    COALESCE(qh.waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms,0) AS wait_cap_ms,
    (COALESCE(qh.waiting_for_compute_duration_ms,0)+COALESCE(qh.waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms,0)) AS queue_ms,
    COALESCE(qh.spilled_local_bytes,0) AS spilled_local_bytes
  FROM system.query.history qh
  WHERE qh.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    AND qh.compute.type = 'WAREHOUSE' AND qh.compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
),
wh_pti AS (
  SELECT b.statement_id, cw.warehouse_name, cw.warehouse_type, cw.warehouse_channel, UPPER(cw.warehouse_size) AS warehouse_size,
         cw.min_clusters, cw.max_clusters, cw.auto_stop_minutes,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.statement_id ORDER BY cw.change_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM base_wh b
  LEFT JOIN system.compute.warehouses cw
    ON cw.workspace_id = b.workspace_id AND cw.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id AND cw.change_time <= b.start_time
),
joined AS (
  SELECT b.workspace_id, b.warehouse_id, p.warehouse_name, p.warehouse_type, p.warehouse_channel,
         p.warehouse_size, p.min_clusters, p.max_clusters, p.auto_stop_minutes,
         b.total_duration_ms, b.wait_cold_ms, b.wait_cap_ms, b.queue_ms, b.spilled_local_bytes
  FROM base_wh b LEFT JOIN wh_pti p ON p.statement_id = b.statement_id AND p.rn = 1
),
agg AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, warehouse_channel,
         warehouse_size, min_clusters, max_clusters, auto_stop_minutes,
         COUNT(*) AS queries, SUM(queue_ms)/60000.0 AS queue_minutes, SUM(wait_cold_ms)/60000.0 AS coldstart_minutes,
         SUM(wait_cap_ms)/60000.0 AS capacity_queue_minutes,
         CAST(SUM(spilled_local_bytes) AS BIGINT)/POWER(1024.0,3) AS spill_gib,
         AVG(total_duration_ms)/1000.0 AS avg_runtime_sec
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY workspace_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, warehouse_channel,
           warehouse_size, min_clusters, max_clusters, auto_stop_minutes
),
sized AS (
  SELECT a.*,
    CASE warehouse_size WHEN '2X_SMALL' THEN 'X_SMALL' WHEN 'X_SMALL' THEN 'SMALL' WHEN 'SMALL' THEN 'MEDIUM'
      WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 'LARGE' WHEN 'LARGE' THEN 'X_LARGE' WHEN 'X_LARGE' THEN '2X_LARGE'
      WHEN '2X_LARGE' THEN '3X_LARGE' WHEN '3X_LARGE' THEN '4X_LARGE' ELSE NULL END AS next_size,
    CASE warehouse_size WHEN 'X_SMALL' THEN '2X_SMALL' WHEN 'SMALL' THEN 'X_SMALL' WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 'SMALL'
      WHEN 'LARGE' THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN 'X_LARGE' THEN 'LARGE' WHEN '2X_LARGE' THEN 'X_LARGE'
      WHEN '3X_LARGE' THEN '2X_LARGE' WHEN '4X_LARGE' THEN '3X_LARGE' ELSE NULL END AS prev_size
  FROM agg a
),
scored AS (SELECT s.*, p.* FROM sized s CROSS JOIN params p),
flags AS (
  SELECT s.*,
    (s.spill_gib >= s.spill_gib_threshold) AS f_spill,
    (s.capacity_queue_minutes >= s.capacity_queue_min_threshold) AS f_capacity,
    (s.coldstart_minutes >= s.coldstart_min_threshold) AS f_cold,
    (s.spill_gib <= s.low_spill_gib_threshold AND s.capacity_queue_minutes <= s.low_capacity_queue_min_threshold
      AND s.queue_minutes <= s.low_total_queue_min_threshold) AS f_low,
    (s.coldstart_minutes >= s.coldstart_min_threshold AND COALESCE(s.auto_stop_minutes,0) <= 15
      AND s.warehouse_type <> 'SERVERLESS') AS f_autostop_increase,
    ((s.spill_gib <= s.low_spill_gib_threshold AND s.capacity_queue_minutes <= s.low_capacity_queue_min_threshold
      AND s.queue_minutes <= s.low_total_queue_min_threshold) AND COALESCE(s.auto_stop_minutes,0) >= 60) AS f_autostop_decrease
  FROM scored s
)
SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, warehouse_size, min_clusters, max_clusters, auto_stop_minutes,
  queries, ROUND(spill_gib,2) AS spill_gib, ROUND(queue_minutes,2) AS queue_minutes,
  ROUND(coldstart_minutes,2) AS coldstart_minutes, ROUND(capacity_queue_minutes,2) AS capacity_queue_minutes,
  CASE
    WHEN f_cold AND warehouse_type <> 'SERVERLESS' THEN 'Recommend SERVERLESS (cold starts high; if staying Classic/Pro, increase auto-stop to 60)'
    WHEN f_spill AND f_capacity AND next_size IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Upsize to ', next_size, ' and raise max_clusters to ', COALESCE(CAST(max_clusters+1 AS STRING),'?'))
    WHEN f_spill AND next_size IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Upsize to ', next_size)
    WHEN f_capacity THEN CONCAT('Raise max_clusters to ', COALESCE(CAST(max_clusters+1 AS STRING),'?'))
    WHEN f_low AND prev_size IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Consider downsizing to ', prev_size)
    WHEN f_autostop_increase THEN 'Increase auto-stop to 60 (reduce cold starts)'
    WHEN f_autostop_decrease THEN 'Decrease auto-stop to 30 (reduce idle cost)'
    ELSE 'No change' END AS recommended_action
FROM flags
WHERE (f_cold AND warehouse_type <> 'SERVERLESS') OR f_capacity OR (f_spill AND next_size IS NOT NULL)
   OR (f_low AND prev_size IS NOT NULL) OR f_autostop_increase OR f_autostop_decrease
ORDER BY f_capacity DESC, f_spill DESC, capacity_queue_minutes DESC, spill_gib DESC
LIMIT 200;

datasets.name: ds_long
queryLines:
WITH wh AS (
  SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) rn
  FROM system.compute.warehouses WHERE delete_time IS NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, qh.compute.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_name,
  qh.executed_by,
  ROUND(qh.total_duration_ms/1000.0,1) AS duration_sec,
  ROUND(COALESCE(qh.waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms,0)/1000.0,1) AS queue_sec,
  ROUND(COALESCE(qh.spilled_local_bytes,0)/POWER(1024.0,3),2) AS spill_gib,
  LEFT(REPLACE(qh.statement_text,'\n',' '),120) AS statement_preview
FROM system.query.history qh
LEFT JOIN wh w ON w.warehouse_id=qh.compute.warehouse_id AND w.rn=1
WHERE qh.start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 7)
  AND qh.compute.type='WAREHOUSE' AND qh.execution_status='FINISHED' AND qh.compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY qh.total_duration_ms DESC LIMIT 50
